name: P/F Elektron hosting / managed IT platform
notes: Confirmed local managed-hosting provider (Faroese: húsíing). Own page lists Húsíing/Netloysnir/KT-trygd; 2022 annual report says hosting department operates ~1,500 servers 24/7; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (DNV certchecker); HPE 2025 customer case documents migration from VMware to Hyper-V/HPE for mission-critical public/financial services. Tórshavn/Streymoy based; facility address and specs not public enough for independent DC-campus classification. No hyperscale or third-party colocation campus confirmed anywhere in FO.

name: Nema Húsíing hosting service
notes: Confirmed hosting service (Nema Húsíing): Nema data-processing agreement states physical data storage is in Føroyar. Nema is a Faroese telecom/broadband/IT provider (founded 2007, Sýn-linked since 2019) with shops in Tórshavn and Klaksvík; physical facility location, size and redundancy not publicly documented.

name: Government 'datacenter B' server room (Landssjúkrahúsið, building B22)
notes: Official public-procurement exemption register (24-08-2022) records 'Keyp av UPS til datacenter B í bygninginum B22, hædd 0' - UPS purchase for 'datacenter B' in building B22. This evidences a government/hospital internal server room (IT infrastructure lead), not a commercial datacenter; buyer = Landssjúkrahúsið. Further procurement lines (2025) show Gjaldstovan/Talgildu Føroyar hosting of critical digital infrastructure with Elektron (MínBoks) - consistent with government hosting via local providers.

name: Føroya Tele / NET network facilities (Klingran 3)
notes: Telecom/network facility lead only: FT and NET confirm headquarters/network facilities at Klingran 3, FO-188 Hoyvík; current public pages do not confirm a commercial colocation/data-center product. FARICE-1 (landing via Funningsfjørður branch, Torshavn service point) and SHEFA-2 (Torshavn landing, FT-owned) are connectivity infrastructure, not datacenters. No AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle public cloud region for FO as of review.
